scripts.build: ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro check && ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro build
scripts.check: prettier --check . && eslint . && knip && SITE_URL=https://portfolio.example pnpm build
scripts.test:update-snapshots: docker run --rm --user root --workdir /work --volume $PWD:/work -e CI=true -e COREPACK_ENABLE_DOWNLOAD_PROMPT=0 -e npm_config_store_dir=/root/.pnpm-store mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.62.1-noble sh -c 'corepack enable && corepack install && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && SITE_URL=https://portfolio.example pnpm test:e2e:update'
